description: Memorial exhibition for Eugene Berman, Philip Evergood, John Folinsbee, Anna Hyatt Huntington, Jacques Lipchitz, and Franklin Watkins, recently deceased members of the National Institute of Arts and Letters and American Academy of Arts and Letters. Held in the Museum of the American Academy of Arts and Letters. Exhibition dates 1974-03-08 to 1974-04-07.
title: Memorial Exhibition in the Museum of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, exhibition catalog
